laws.rule: Parque Nacional Laguna Lachuá: do not use sunscreen, soap or shampoo inside the lagoon. Open fires are not permitted. The guide initially says no cooking with firewood but later mentions designated barbecues with brought-in firewood; confirm the permitted cooking equipment with INAB rather than extending this into an unqualified wood-use ban. A gas stove is mentioned as an option.
